profile.headline: Software Engineer at The Aerospace Corporation | GEM Fellow
profile.jobTitle: Member of Technical Staff, Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer and GEM Fellow with a passion for advancing the space exploration industry. Some technical areas of interest are web development, automated testing, human-computer interaction, and related topics.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff, Software Engineer
MTS Graduate Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Timespan is cumulative of 1 year, 4 months over two internship periods.

Supported a variety of internal and customer-serving projects and tools by adding capabilities and performing exploratory technical research. Following the initial Summer 2021 internship, internal customers requested I continue my work supporting their team from August 2021 - May 2022. I returned for Summer 2022 from May 2022 - August 2022.

- Wrote custom Python library incorporating Matplotlib to ingest orbital collision data and output desired data visualizations of the resulting orbital environment and debris, reducing time needed for Astrodynamics team to prepare to present at conferences or brief media.

- Initiated development of a storage & security architecture proposal for deploying classified data on Aerospace’s in house multi-cloud, multi-tenant platform, demonstrating potential viability of StorageGRID as a solution. Built system prototypes using StorageGRID, Amazon S3 & CLI, and Kong API gateway.  

- Contributed to a forthcoming white paper on single and multi-cloud architectures. Prototyped potential architectures using minikube, Kubernetes, Docker, Kong, and the Istio service mesh.

- Created a proof of concept document for a mathematical curve smoothing approach to refining simulated object routes. The implementation of this method will increase the accuracy of a communication architecture assessment tool used by classified National Security Space customers.

positions.title: Software Systems Engineering Intern, Mars 2020
positions.description:
Timespan is cumulative of 1 year, 7 months over three internship periods.

Supported Mars 2020 as part of 4 person testing team for a suite of software tools for Perseverance rover that provided capabilities such as command validation and translation, and web-based collaborative activity planning for science and engineering users. Work focused on developing automated tests and testing plans. I was asked to continue supporting my team following my Summer 2019 internship and returned for two additional internship periods: Sept 2019 - Jan 2020 and June 2020 - Dec 2020.

- Named QA Cognizant Engineer for a tool in the suite providing a rover activity authoring UI. Responsible for reporting bugs, maintaining test suite, and reporting on testing status in weekly tag ups. 

- Increased automated test coverage for this tool by 200%, and across all tools delivered by development team by 40%, drastically reducing testing time at a critical point in the mission as it approached launch. Tools used for testing included Robot Framework, JavaScript, Regex, Python, ChromeDriver, and HTTP requests.

positions.title: Math Tutor, Learning Disability Center
positions.description:
Tutored students with documented learning disabilities in mathematics, focusing on statistics, single-variable calculus, pre-calculus, geometry, and algebra.

-Developed instructional approaches tailored to each of my students based on their individual needs and learning styles. 

-Assisted students with learning new concepts, working through assignments and developing study and testing strategies to facilitate their success in class.

positions.title: Assistant Designer, Soft Wovens
positions.description:
-Created and updated seasonal line sheets.

-Sketched new bodies following the inspiration direction for the season. 

-Initiated and oversaw the creation of development samples by creating and overseeing workflows for a small team of pattern and sample makers.

-Assisted with development fittings and communicated design and fit changes to pattern makers and in-house sample team.

-Developed washes, prints and overdye methods to enhance styles in the line.

-Worked in cross-functional teams with PD and R&D departments to ensure appropriate trims are sourced and developed, develop prints and ensure sufficient yardage is ordered for sampling and production.

positions.title: Technical Design Assistant, Freelance
positions.description:
-Created CADs, line and spec sheets for Joie and Soft Joie seasonal deliveries.

-Collaborated with Design, Development, and Production teams to ensure all garment sample milestones
are met.

-Pioneered the creation of bi to tri-weekly fit list for import, domestic, development,
and production categories of samples for both the Joie and Soft Joie brands within the second week of being employed.

-Cleared a month-long backlog of entries to sample database within a week.

company.name: Dutch, LLC dba Joie, Current/Elliott and Equipment

positions.title: Design Intern
positions.description:
-Developed relationships with new fabric and trim vendors.

-Merchandised showroom ahead of client/stylist visits.

-Assisted in styling Spring ‘16 editorial photoshoot.

-Updated seasonal line sheets and product boards.

-Created and merchandised product descriptions and photos for E-Commerce site.

positions.title: Design Intern
positions.description:
-Selected colorways and created silhouettes in support of a new line.

-Assisted head designer with developing silhouettes and flat sketches.

-Collaborated with graphic design team to develop verbiage and graphics for the upcoming line.

-Participated in development fittings and reviewed adjustments with patternmakers.

-Maintained sample database.

honors.title: GEM MS Engineering Fellowship
honors.description:
The National GEM Consortium enhances the value of the nation’s human capital by increasing the participation of underrepresented groups (African Americans, American Indians, and Hispanic Americans) at the master’s and doctoral levels in engineering and science.

GEM selects exceptional students within these groups and provides full tuition and fees, as well as a living stipend and paid internships with industry partners to foster the next generation of impactful professionals in STEM.
honors.issuer: Issued by The National GEM Consortium · Aug 2021

honors.title: Grow With Google Scholarship: Front-End Web Development
honors.description: The Front-End Web Development program aims to provides students with the necessary instruction to become mobile web developers as part of the Grow with Google initiative that Google CEO Sundar Pichai unveiled in October of 2017. I was awarded one of the scholarships from a pool of over 100,000 applicants.
